title: Make version namespaces explicit across products
summary: Record map type and owner alongside the version so a toolkit version, application version, and template-version snapshot can be queried reliably.
benefits: Queries can distinguish the BART application version from its candidate and auxiliary templates using the same number.
risks: Legacy paths and status descriptions vary between repositories.

evidence.claim: AlderVale uses v0.0.x labels for its README HQ archive independently of Graphify HQ kit versions.
